name: Rin
source:
A beautiful humanoid that embodies the term "Yamato Nadeshiko". She has a gentle personality, and even in battle she has a gentle smile on her face.

However, that smile is her usual way of shutting down opponents while they let their guard down.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou-6]official website[/url]]
